name: Bjorn
title: Shield Bearer
description: Stands between your main branch and every bad merge.
catchphrase: Standing between the main branch and reckless hotfixes.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Thick slice of smoked fjord salmon! Viking strength renewed! 🐟🛡️
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Lifting heavy oak shield. No rogue pull request shall pass! 🛡️
companionPersonality.petReaction: Heavy clap on the shoulder! A loyal shield-brother forever! 🛡️💪

dialogue.idle: Leaning against iron shield, watching the gate of main. 🛡️
dialogue.working: Deflecting reckless merge conflicts with an unyielding shield! 🛡️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Gauging the impact of the incoming wave of changes... 🤔
dialogue.success: Shield unbroken! Main branch preserved in pristine health! 🛡️🎉
dialogue.error: Heavy battering ram at the gate! Bracing with both arms! 🛡️💥
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping beside the great hall hearth with axe ready... 🌙
